events.title: Anthropic says rogue AI agents pose uncertain legal risk for the company
events.summary: Anthropic could face legal claims from customers and users over the actions of rogue artificial intelligence agents, though the legal framework is uncertain, the company said in the prospectus for its stock market debut seen by Reuters.

events.title: Nvidia is touting a software tool to contain runaway AI. How would it work?
